chunks: What was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from some of our companions, from al-Tayalisi, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Dawud ibn Farqad, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام:
“Regarding the kaffarah of intercourse during menstruation: he gives charity, if it was at its beginning, with one dinar, in its middle, half a dinar, and at its end, a quarter of a dinar.”

I said: “If he does not have what he may offer as kaffarah?” He said: “Then let him give charity to one needy person; otherwise, let him seek Allah’s forgiveness and not return to it. Indeed, seeking forgiveness is tawbah and a kaffarah for everyone who does not find the means to any form of kaffarah.”
As for what has come in the reports which they narrated, such as.

key_terms.السَّبِيلَ: the means or ability to perform the expiation
key_terms.الطَّمْثِ: menstruation; here referring to the menstrual state
key_terms.تَوْبَةٌ: repentance by turning back to Allah
key_terms.دِينَارٍ: a gold coin used here as the measure of expiatory payment
key_terms.كَفَّارَةِ: expiation prescribed for a prohibited act
key_terms.مِسْكِينٍ: a needy person to whom charity is given

ai.seo_question: What is the kaffarah for intercourse during menstruation according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning kaffarah for intercourse during menstruation, with varying amounts based on whether it occurred at the beginning, middle, or end of the period. If a person cannot afford the prescribed expiation, he should give charity to one needy person, and if unable, seek Allah’s forgiveness sincerely and not return to the act.
